name: Demeclocycline Hydrochloride

fda.text: DEMECLOCYCLINE HYDROCHLORIDE, LIKE OTHER TETRACYCLINE-CLASS ANTIBIOTICS, CAN CAUSE FETAL HARM WHEN ADMINISTERED TO A PREGNANT WOMAN. summary: According to official warnings, Demeclocycline Hydrochloride can cause harm to an unborn baby if it is taken during pregnancy [3]. If a person uses this drug while pregnant or becomes pregnant during treatment, they should be informed of these potential risks to the developing baby [3]. Additionally, a small computer model rather than testing on people estimated a high liver score of 77 and a low heart score of 39 [M].
